triage.note: The mutation half of ui-font-link-nonblocking, in the S5 `-regression` shape (expect.min_failures == max_failures pins an EXACT count, so a regressed miss and a regressed over-fire both go red). The fixture carries six links and exactly two must fire: (3) a second external sheet with the media/onload attributes removed — the 'attribute removed' and 'second blocking link' mutations are the same tag — and (4) a `media=print` sheet with no onload, which never applies on screen. The four that must NOT fire are the shipped fix itself, its `<noscript>` fallback, a same-origin sheet, and an HTML-commented-out link. A check that pinned the literal attribute string instead of the property would count (1) green by accident and (4) green by mistake; this fixture is what says it does neither.

provenance: S3 follow-up PR, created 2026-08-22, alongside the check. Run against the fixture: 2 failures (links 3 and 4), exactly as expected; against index.html at origin/main d271547: 1 failure (the live defect); against index.html after the fix: 0.
